premises.text: Current digital experiences fail to provide true personalization due to siloed user data.
premises.evidence_span: these actions are not put into a time context. What that means is Rock Out cannot distinguish between me buying a present for my friend weeks ago to an upcoming concert that I myself am attending.

premises.text: Individuals have multiple online identities that complicate personalized experiences.
premises.evidence_span: a typical person has at least ten different identities, online and offline, from social handles, to alternate emails, to mobile numbers, to unique IDs from every single website and app that we work with every day.

premises.text: Brainify creates a comprehensive profile by aggregating user data from various online sources.
premises.evidence_span: we create the most robust, dynamic, and encrypted profile of an individual. We do this by tying together information from across the web.

premises.text: Brainify's engine can prioritize product recommendations based on time-aligned user activities.
premises.evidence_span: By looking at the current timeline from beyond one website or app, our engine can make the most intelligent decisions and predictions specific to you right now.

premises.text: Brainify's API allows companies to integrate and utilize digital DNA for personalized experiences.
premises.evidence_span: Brainify's API allows any company to harness the power of digital DNA and deliver truly hyper-relevant experiences for every user.

premises.text: Seamless integration of Brainify's API enhances user experience on client websites.
premises.evidence_span: the data that's being sent back to Rockout will be mapped in the exact format that Rockout needs, making it a truly seamless integration.

value.text: Users receive hyper-relevant product recommendations based on their digital DNA.
value.evidence_span: Brainify enables sites like Rockout to really be able to deliver a truly hyper-relevant experience for each and every user.
